description: Fetch recent posts carrying one hashtag, each a full post. Use this for trend and campaign monitoring. Costs 64 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1–24. A page can hold fewer while `next_cursor` is set: read until it is null.

name: get_instagram_hashtag
title: Get recent posts for an Instagram hashtag
